run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded run - outbound HTTPS via WebFetch was again entirely blocked by the environment network egress policy (blanket block re-confirmed this run: example.com AND www.tenders.gov.au both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and the agent proxy status endpoint reported recentRelayFailures: [] - an organisation-level egress restriction, not a per-site fault; per /root/.ccr/README.md such policy denials are reported, not routed around). Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch surfaced genuine, currently-relevant buyer-originated opportunities and portals across Tier 1 (AusTender ATMs, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT), Tier 2 (Inner West Council via VendorPanel, University of Sydney and Macquarie University via TenderLink, GBE water corporations Sydney Water and Melbourne Water) and Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne - both registration/login-gated). Every tender below is captured at HEADLINE level only: because no tender detail page or specification document could be opened via WebFetch, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, exact values and contacts are UNVERIFIED and left null/empty unless a fact appeared directly in a buyer-originated search snippet. Each tender is flagged in its notes and counted in entries_pending_detail. Opportunities whose only known closing date had already passed before the run date (e.g. NSW Jervis Bay Road artwork closing 19-Aug-2026; the AusTender ASD/Home Affairs/ANMM/ATO/Defence ATMs closing 26-Aug-2026) were excluded rather than presented as open. Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs were checked and are entirely registration/login-gated: no publicly-visible corporate RFx detail was accessible, so no corporate tenders were invented; those portals are recorded in discovered_sources with access_method=portal-registration. Source discovery still ran and found three genuinely new buyer-originated council sources not already in the known set (Murray River Council NSW, Southern Downs Regional Council QLD, Kempsey Shire Council NSW).
gaps: WebFetch / outbound HTTPS is entirely blocked by the environment egress policy (EGRESS_BLOCKED on every host tested this run, including example.com and www.tenders.gov.au; agent proxy status reported no recent relay failures). No tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so all deliverables/requirements/evaluation/value/contact fields are null and every tender is headline-level only.

Tier 1 core portals (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) could only be searched via WebSearch, not fetched. Concrete open-tender rows with verified IDs/closing times for VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS and ACT were not retrievable at row level from search snippets this run and are deferred to a future run when egress is available.

buy.nsw/NSW eTendering opportunities were surfaced with titles and closing dates from search snippets but individual RFT deep links (RFTUUID) could not be confirmed against the buyer's own notice because detail pages were unreachable; buy.nsw opportunity-search URL recorded instead of a per-tender deep link.

AusTender deep-linked ATMs (RFT-2026-0080, ATM_2026_6786, ATM_2026_6026, ATM_2026_6066, OET-DRC-2026) were surfaced with structured Atm/Show URLs but no title/closing date could be read from the snippet; only RFT-2026-0080 is recorded (headline id + URL, title pending) and the remainder are deferred.

Power and Water Corporation (NT GBE) tender closing 23-Sep-2026 14:00 ACST surfaced via QTOL search but its title was not in the snippet and the detail page (tendersonline.nt.gov.au) is login-gated; recorded at headline level with title pending.

Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, EstimateOne construction subcontractor packages, RangeMe, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue supplier portals) are registration- or login-gated; no publicly-visible RFx detail was accessible. Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate opportunities fabricated.

Invitation-only management-consultancy and panel RFPs, and the DFAT Development Procurement Pipeline (released only to shortlisted organisations), are out of scope - not publicly discoverable and not recorded as tenders.
